title: Point at the Mulberry Tree While Cursing the Locust Tree
era: End of Qin · about 2,200 years ago

source.chapter: Point at the Mulberry While Cursing the Locust
source.quote: When the great overawe the small, they warn them and so lead them. Firm and central, and there is response; through danger, and it goes smoothly.

moral: No names, no head-on fight — say it another way and he takes it in himself.
keywords: Say it to the one who hears
transfer: When words are hard, tell a short story instead.
